base_specs.body:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: kit_frames, standalone reusable game UI ATLAS, ONE wide 16:9 image, target 2048x1152. Hand-painted opaque digital gouache with expressive pressure-varied black ink contours, heavy outer contour and finer interior lines, angular cut edges, visible selective dry brush, crisp large FLAT shadow shapes and strong chiaroscuro. Refined dark maritime narrative UI matching the approved dialogue and boon reference images: ink-navy / sea-gray backplates, brushed forged iron and aged bronze fittings, very thin worn gold inlay, occasional nautical rope, ship rivets and small bell motifs. Saturated cyan-green one-sided soulfire edge light only where undead/energy is shown; living kingdom accents warm ivory-gold. Highly legible limited palette, quiet interiors. NO 3D render, no photorealism, no low-poly triangular faceting, no airbrushed gradients, no glossy mobile-game look, no ornate generic filigree, no existing game/artist/studio names, no watermark.
Solid perfectly flat dark navy background #0b101a, no scenery or cast shadow outside assets. Orthographic FRONT VIEW, no tilt. All pieces separate, at least 40px empty gutters, full outlines visible within 40px outer margin, easy future rectangular slicing. Make panel interiors very quiet matte ink-blue.
Layout: TOP row one long EMPTY DIALOGUE BOX occupying 74% width, angular forged iron border, thin gold inner rule, rope only at four corners, small bronze bell suspended from top center. Beside it one independent vertical EMPTY LOCATION PANEL, with upper title compartment and room for body copy. MIDDLE row: independent elongated EMPTY SPEAKER NAMEPLATE with clipped corners; independent smaller EMPTY LOCATION TITLE PLATE suspended by a short rope; three visually identical shaped action buttons side by side labeled exactly "常态", "悬停", "按下". Normal button dark iron/thin bronze; hover thin warm-gold illuminated edge; pressed slightly inset dark fill and lowered inner trim. BOTTOM row: one horizontal SCROLLBAR track and separate matching thumb plus one vertical SCROLLBAR and its separate thumb; three distinct horizontal DIVIDERS with subtle central bell / knot / rivet, and two spare rope corner pieces. Tiny ivory captions outside the pieces may identify "对话框" "地点面板" "名牌" "地点标题" "滚动条" "分隔线". Do not put body text inside empty frames. No portrait, no cards, no decorative overlapping, no clutter, no pseudo-language. Keep cuts and empty central surfaces clean. One atlas only.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: kit_boon_frames, a reusable BOON CARD FRAME ATLAS, one wide16:9 image target2048x1152. Hand-painted opaque digital gouache with expressive pressure-varied black ink contours, heavy outer contour and finer interior lines, angular cut edges, visible selective dry brush, crisp large FLAT shadow shapes and strong chiaroscuro. Refined dark maritime narrative UI matching the approved dialogue and boon reference images: ink-navy / sea-gray backplates, brushed forged iron and aged bronze fittings, very thin worn gold inlay, occasional nautical rope, ship rivets and small bell motifs. Saturated cyan-green one-sided soulfire edge light only where undead/energy is shown; living kingdom accents warm ivory-gold. Highly legible limited palette, quiet interiors. NO 3D render, no photorealism, no low-poly triangular faceting, no airbrushed gradients, no glossy mobile-game look, no ornate generic filigree, no existing game/artist/studio names, no watermark.
Flat solid #0b101a background, no scenery. FIVE equally sized tall portrait CARD FRAMES placed in ONE straight horizontal row with 45px clean empty gutters, complete frames and ample outer margins. Match steel/bronze rectangular clipped-corner frame construction of the approved boon cards, thin gold edges. Each card has its own inset object ICON in top crest, exact Chinese owner NAME in header, a large EMPTY dark image window, one thin divider and two EMPTY text slots. Empty windows must stay blank; these are reusable frames with no illustration or invented effects. Five cards left to right:
1 "伯纳德": STEEL GRAY frame, muted purple secondary cloth, SHIELD icon, fine cold steel blue edge highlight.
2 "玛蒂尔达": RUST RED frame, leather brown secondary, curved NEEDLE AND THREAD icon, tiny pale cyan stitch highlight.
3 "奥斯温": SLATE BLUE frame, old parchment inset, SLATE TABLET icon with simple engraved lines, tiny green light accent.
4 "皮普": COPPER GOLD frame, navy secondary, BRASS BUGLE icon, warm copper highlight.
5 "渡魂人": INK BLACK frame with restrained CYAN GREEN inlay, single hooded LANTERN icon, no face. The ferryman card must NOT have a slot label.
BOTTOM separate strip has exactly THREE standalone rarity CORNER BADGES, each badge a right-angled triangular metal corner attachment that can sit on the upper-right of a card: ordinary steel/bronze labeled "普通", rare desaturated blue/silver labeled "稀有", epic deep violet/gold labeled "史诗". Only owner names and these three rarity labels. Do not add character portraits, numbers, extra cards, legendary rarity, effects or fake script. Symmetry of card sizes, legibility, flat empty background, all components fully separated.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset kit_icons, one clean 16:9 wide2048x1152 reusable ICON ATLAS. Hand-painted opaque digital gouache with expressive pressure-varied black ink contours, heavy outer contour and finer interior lines, angular cut edges, visible selective dry brush, crisp large FLAT shadow shapes and strong chiaroscuro. Refined dark maritime narrative UI matching the approved dialogue and boon reference images: ink-navy / sea-gray backplates, brushed forged iron and aged bronze fittings, very thin worn gold inlay, occasional nautical rope, ship rivets and small bell motifs. Saturated cyan-green one-sided soulfire edge light only where undead/energy is shown; living kingdom accents warm ivory-gold. Highly legible limited palette, quiet interiors. NO 3D render, no photorealism, no low-poly triangular faceting, no airbrushed gradients, no glossy mobile-game look, no ornate generic filigree, no existing game/artist/studio names, no watermark.
Exactly TWENTY separate square icon cells arranged as a strict FIVE COLUMNS x FOUR ROWS grid, equal spacing, flat uniform ink-navy background, no cell boxes, no metal frames, no scenery. Each icon occupies upper70% of its cell; one exact Chinese label centered BELOW in quiet ivory Chinese printed calligraphic type. All twenty labels below their own icon, no title and no extra writing. Monochrome aged ivory INK DRAWING with ONE and only one small accent color per icon; thick pressure-varied outlines, flat fill, simplest readable silhouette, no 3D shading. Distinct icon choices avoid ambiguity:
Row1 left-right: "旧部增益" = small shield with a four-point blessing spark, accent steel blue; "招募" = three simple helmet silhouettes and a plus, accent muted gold; "魂火" = small upright flame in an open palm, accent cyan-green; "缝补" = curved surgical needle and looped thread, accent rust red; "休整" = folded bedroll beneath a shelter arc, accent muted blue.
Row2: "遗物" = ancient broken crown token, accent copper; "航海" = boat with a small triangular sail, accent sea blue; "知识" = open annotated manuscript, accent parchment gold; "刃" = single diagonal sword, accent muted gold; "阵" = three aligned shields, accent steel blue.
Row3: "行军" = boot with two forward chevrons, accent copper; "冥火" = sharp spiraling flame around a tiny bolt, accent cyan-green, visually different from palm-held 魂火 currency; "招魂" = a hand rising above a skull, accent cyan-green; "破阵" = visibly split broken shield, accent orange; "缝线" = stitched seam with three visible stitches, accent pale cyan.
Row4: "冥燃" = skull topped with small flame, accent cyan-green; "惊惶" = startled helmet with short radial lines, accent amber; "沉" = weighted anchor with downward arrow, accent sea teal; "残响" = echoing concentric broken rings, accent cyan-green; "钟数" = nautical bell with tally marks, accent bronze gold.
Preserve order exactly, all labels correctly spelled and readable, no duplicates or omitted cells. Accent colors restricted to small area, ivory dominates. Clean empty gutters so each icon and label can be sliced independently. All20 cells same visual weight.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset ui_hub, one complete16:9 wide game HUB SCREEN target2048x1152, not an atlas. Hand-painted opaque digital gouache with expressive pressure-varied black ink contours, heavy outer contour and finer interior lines, angular cut edges, visible selective dry brush, crisp large FLAT shadow shapes and strong chiaroscuro. Refined dark maritime narrative UI matching the approved dialogue and boon reference images: ink-navy / sea-gray backplates, brushed forged iron and aged bronze fittings, very thin worn gold inlay, occasional nautical rope, ship rivets and small bell motifs. Saturated cyan-green one-sided soulfire edge light only where undead/energy is shown; living kingdom accents warm ivory-gold. Highly legible limited palette, quiet interiors. NO 3D render, no photorealism, no low-poly triangular faceting, no airbrushed gradients, no glossy mobile-game look, no ornate generic filigree, no existing game/artist/studio names, no watermark.
The canonical Bellgrave sunken-wreck deck: a raised salvaged wooden wreck above a storm-dark gray sea, ruined masts and slack ropes, half-submerged bronze bell visible beyond railing, broken hull silhouettes, ink blue storm clouds. Slight elevated three-quarter camera; dark readable foreground deck, no 3D render. This is a narrative environment UI scene with exactly FIVE named old companions as small but readable full-body angular ADULT figures placed at five separate interactive stations, not a portrait/turnaround sheet. No duplicate characters, no extra NPCs, no Prince needed. Each is visibly undead, avoid gore.
From left to right: Bernard at muster post with worn shield, broad heavy closed naval helm and narrow cyan visor, worn ivory/bronze steel-gray armor and purple mantle, no human face or horns; Matilda at surgeon's worktable, sturdy38-year-old woman with tied hair, ashen stitched skin, rolled navy sleeves, rust-red cloth and brown leather medical apron, gloves, needle/thread/tool roll, NOT blacksmith/no prosthesis; Oswin at chart desk, thin43-year-old bone-faced lich scholar in short hood and slate-blue layered robe with solid feet, slate tablet and a few loose pages, no halo/crown/staff; Pip by mainmast, young ADULT19-year-old skeletal sailor, short navy tunic, rust-red neck scarf, boots, oversized copper bugle and small broken-crown pennant, lively but not child; Ferryman far right by rail, tallest slim FLOATING figure with COMPLETE intact ink-black maritime ceremonial vestments with subdued bronze edging, FACELESS hood, translucent cyan-green robe hems, wooden oar and ONE lantern, no face, no armor/no rags/no halo. Undead one-sided cyan-green light, auxiliary colors remain visible.
Readable small unobtrusive bronze/iron NAMEPLATES near their feet exactly "伯纳德" "玛蒂尔达" "奥斯温" "皮普" "渡魂人". Top center dark rope-suspended location plaque exact "沉钟湾". Top left compact counter with concentric echo-ring icon exact "残响 240"; beside it nautical bell icon exact "钟数 2". These are mockup counter values only, no items lying around suggesting permanent inventory. Bottom center large but restrained forged-iron bronze-edged button exact "出征", route-arrow icon, clear cyan-green hover edge. Rest of interface minimal, no added quest/gacha/store menus, no labels naming new places, no exposition. Moody painting, characters brighter than deck, strong silhouettes, full UI safe margins.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset ui_hud, one16:9 complete tactical BATTLE HUD SCREEN target2048x1152, composition following approved battle reference. Hand-painted opaque digital gouache with expressive pressure-varied black ink contours, heavy outer contour and finer interior lines, angular cut edges, visible selective dry brush, crisp large FLAT shadow shapes and strong chiaroscuro. Refined dark maritime narrative UI matching the approved dialogue and boon reference images: ink-navy / sea-gray backplates, brushed forged iron and aged bronze fittings, very thin worn gold inlay, occasional nautical rope, ship rivets and small bell motifs. Saturated cyan-green one-sided soulfire edge light only where undead/energy is shown; living kingdom accents warm ivory-gold. Highly legible limited palette, quiet interiors. NO 3D render, no photorealism, no low-poly triangular faceting, no airbrushed gradients, no glossy mobile-game look, no ornate generic filigree, no existing game/artist/studio names, no watermark.
Pulled-back orthographic camera at approximately30-degree downward angle, no horizon, stepped broad gray-olive grassy island fills most of frame, layered dark blue-gray cliff walls, sparse angular fir trees at left and right, small royal ivory flag on upper plateau, gray sea and fog along edge. Large quiet traversable ground patches. Main sword/shield clash just below center and a second squad near upper middle, no foreground hero.
Tiny ordinary battle troops use2.3-head-tall silhouettes, 3–4 flat color blocks, two flat values per material, thick ink outline; standing soldier height about4% of screen. Undead purple/slate with localized cyan-green rimlight; living defenders ivory-gold armor and warm-gold rimlight ONLY. Readable separation between troops; restrained cyan slash and warm weapon contact spark, no explosion obscuring units. Field stays secondary to evaluating UI, muted values.
UPPER LEFT exactly THREE compact troop-selection cards stacked vertically, inset dark iron and fine bronze edges. Each has one clear infantry pictogram at LEFT and large count at RIGHT plus small exact type label: first sword-and-shield skull "剑盾" "9/9", second skull spearman "长枪" "7/9", third skeletal bow "弓兵" "8/9". FIRST card SELECTED with unmistakable thin cyan-green perimeter, tiny corner tick and slightly lighter steel fill; other2 unselected dark. Icons readable, counts high contrast, cards not blocking center.
BOTTOM CENTER one long slim iron-rimmed ENERGY BAR labeled EXACT "冥火", cyan-green fill at roughly65%, subtle tiny flame icon, no other resource meters.
UPPER RIGHT one modest boss HEALTH BAR with warm ivory-gold fill roughly70%, dark bronze framed. Exact name "休元帅" above bar, small command-pennant boss emblem left. This is a UI sample of known marshal, no large portrait or boss character required on field. Keep bar thinner than troop cards, all HUD inside safe margins.
No debug text, game title, minimap, hotkey tutorial, floating combat numbers, invented abilities, extra frames or huge health panel. One screenshot-like complete HUD design.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset ui_ending, one16:9 complete ENDING CARD SCREEN target2048x1152. Hand-painted opaque digital gouache with expressive pressure-varied black ink contours, heavy outer contour and finer interior lines, angular cut edges, visible selective dry brush, crisp large FLAT shadow shapes and strong chiaroscuro. Refined dark maritime narrative UI matching the approved dialogue and boon reference images: ink-navy / sea-gray backplates, brushed forged iron and aged bronze fittings, very thin worn gold inlay, occasional nautical rope, ship rivets and small bell motifs. Saturated cyan-green one-sided soulfire edge light only where undead/energy is shown; living kingdom accents warm ivory-gold. Highly legible limited palette, quiet interiors. NO 3D render, no photorealism, no low-poly triangular faceting, no airbrushed gradients, no glossy mobile-game look, no ornate generic filigree, no existing game/artist/studio names, no watermark.
E01 canonical outcome: Edmund claims throne, compulsory military oath KEPT, artificial daylight CONTINUES, ordinary ending will Return. This is an aftermath narrative illustration within a designed UI, not the true ending and not a branching choice menu.
LEFT45%: angular adult26-year-old undead Edmund seated upright on a somber stone throne, solitary and emotionally distant. White-gold old armor, torn purple cloak, dark swept hair, broken gold crown, one half of his face visibly skull with restrained cyan-green soulfire at skull eye, human half proud but hollow, one side saturated cyan-green rimlight. Tall intact white-gold windows behind him imply the ongoing artificial Day; keep it muted, NO sunset. At a distance before throne two small ranks of closed-helmet undead guards remain under orders, silhouettes only; no new named people, no Ferryman physical portrait needed. No joyful coronation crowd, no free spirits departing, no dispersing army, no destruction of sun mechanism.
RIGHT55% a calm empty dark ink-blue text field enclosed by forged-iron thin aged gold/bronze border, small bell and rope corner ornament, generous padding. Clear hierarchy and exactly this Chinese copy, no added exposition:
small eyebrow "E01"
very large title "灰烬王冠"
body paragraph in three or four readable horizontal lines, verbatim: "王冠复归，在证据允许范围内平反，亡灵卫队站在王座前。妹妹可能留在宫廷或退居别处，军团仍受命令束缚。王子发现胜利能够恢复身份，却不能让生前生活回来。"
A thin bronze divider.
small speaker "渡魂人"
large readable quote on two lines, verbatim: "那么，陛下。一切都如你所愿吗？"
BOTTOM in text field one clear bronze-edged dark button exact "回溯到沉钟湾".
Ivory Chinese printed calligraphic typography, dense paragraph smaller than quote but still legible. All text exact, horizontally laid out, generous margins, no gibberish or English beyond E01. No credits, save completion, choice buttons or new story facts. Text and somber throne image balanced, grayscale values clean, visual match approved dialogue frame.

note: 每次实际调用的完整提示词见GENERATION-LOG.json；RESULTS.json记录选用主图提示词。
